chars.SAID: SAID: a very tall, very skinny young man wearing a mustard-yellow polo shirt and dark brown chino trousers, a thin black moustache drawn on his face.
chars.SANAA: SANAA: a young woman wearing a pastel pink house kaftan with white embroidery and a white scrunchie on her wrist.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: SANAA stands at the mirror combing her long black hair (a long black hairpiece) and smiling at herself, while SAID stands right behind her holding her pink smartphone, looking at it with a sly curious grin, in a modest Moroccan apartment bedroom with zellige-tiled floor, a wooden wardrobe and a mirror.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot: SAID sits on the edge of the bed holding a pink smartphone with both hands, screen glowing on his face, eyebrows raised with curiosity, in a modest Moroccan apartment bedroom with zellige-tiled floor, a wooden wardrobe and a mirror.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a cosy Moroccan living room with low sedari sofas, SANAA laughs while filming SAID with her phone held up; SAID poses awkwardly making a silly peace sign, unaware.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: SAID stands frozen in the middle of the room staring at the pink phone, eyes wide in shock, jaw dropped, one hand on his head, in a modest Moroccan apartment bedroom with zellige-tiled floor, a wooden wardrobe and a mirror.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small Moroccan neighbourhood drogerie shop full of shelves of products, SAID stocks shelves while SANAA secretly films him from behind the counter with her phone, giggling.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: SAID sits on the bed hunched over the pink phone, sweating heavily, face red with embarrassment, biting his fist, in a modest Moroccan apartment bedroom with zellige-tiled floor, a wooden wardrobe and a mirror.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Over-the-shoulder view: SAID taps the pink phone screen with one finger, leaning in nervously, glow on his face, in a modest Moroccan apartment bedroom with zellige-tiled floor, a wooden wardrobe and a mirror.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan living room at night, SAID dances goofily with arms in the air and a silly face, SANAA dances next to him laughing, a small speaker on the table.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: SAID screams in horror holding the pink phone at arm's length, while SANAA turns from the mirror with the comb in her hand, looking at him surprised, in a modest Moroccan apartment bedroom with zellige-tiled floor, a wooden wardrobe and a mirror.
